feedback.problem:
Which of the matrices below does **not** have an inverse?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}4 & 3 \\ -2 & -1\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}4 & 12 \\ 3 & 9\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
- The matrix $A$ is a $3\times 2$ matrix. So, it is not invertible.

- For the matrix $B$, we have

$$
det(B)=4\cdot (-1)-(-2)\cdot 3=2.
$$

Because $det(B)\ne 0,$ we conclude that $B$ is invertible.

- For the matrix $C$, we have

$$
det(C)=4\cdot 9-3\cdot 12=0.
$$

Because $det(C)=0,$ we conclude that $C$ is not invertible.

Therefore, only $A$ and $C$ do not have an inverse.
